tools.name: nastech_compile_speech
tools.description: Compile English NastechML into a validated local Supertonic expression plan without running synthesis.

markup.description: English NastechML. Example: <speak><emotion name="sad">I miss home.</emotion><sound type="sigh" /></speak>

voice.description: Optional built-in Supertonic voice name, normally M1–M5 or F1–F5.

tools.name: nastech_generate_speech
tools.description: Generate local English expressive WAV audio with Supertonic ONNX. No cloud provider call is made.

http.response: audio/wav bytes with X-Nastech-Request-Id, X-Nastech-Runtime, and X-Nastech-Duration-Seconds headers

tools.name: nastech_runtime_diagnostics
tools.description: Read the active CPU policy, model load state, cache state, and synthesis metrics.

tools.name: nastech_warmup_runtime
tools.description: Load the local ONNX runtime and generate a short local warm-up synthesis before production traffic.

tools.name: nastech_clear_runtime_cache
tools.description: Discard cached local WAV responses without unloading the ONNX model sessions.
